ASBTaskCard.description: A bounded, reproducible scientific task extracted from a peer-reviewed paper. Links a task to its research question, finding, inputs, outputs, tools, required skills, workflow description, and evaluation strategy. Runtime mirror: the ASBTaskCard dataclass of the reference pipeline (schema v0.18.0).

abstraction_frame.description: Abstraction frame of the task in the paper-level entity spine; null when no spine was built

article_type.description: Article type classification (e.g. research-article, review, software-tool)

artifact_refs.description: Bindings of prose inputs and outputs to typed locators (files, URLs) found by enrichment or in the package index, one JSON object per binding

available_artifacts.description: Artifacts accessible from the paper package (path, role, indexable, sha256)

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this card was created

crossref_doi.description: DOI of the source article (Crossref format)

data_accessions.description: Public repository accessions (MassIVE, PRIDE, MetaboLights, GEO, etc.) mined from article text

data_in.description: Format-typed descriptions of the inputs, one per entry of inputs and in the same order

data_out.description: Format-typed descriptions of the expected outputs, one per entry of expected_outputs and in the same order

domain_knowledge.description: Domain-specific knowledge items required for the task

evaluation_strategy.description: Structured evaluation plan with direct_checks and expert_review lists, aligned with p-plan:Plan

evidence_snippets.description: Verbatim text snippets from the source paper supporting this card

executable.description: A runnable command for the task; null when no command is available

execution_environment.description: Software, hardware and scheduler context that ran or is required to run the card; null when not recorded

execution_profile.description: Declared execution requirements: compute tier, commercial software and open-source alternatives

expected_artifact_name.description: SAB-aligned canonical output filename (equivalent to SAB output_fname)

finding.description: The paper's answer or result for this task

finding_evidence_span.description: Verbatim passage of the source that supports finding; null when none was selected

github_name.description: GitHub repository name (owner/repo) associated with the source article

input_from.description: task_id of a prior sub-task whose output is this card's first input (chaining)

inputs.description: Human-readable input descriptions for the task

keywords.description: Free-form keywords extracted from the source (methods, domains, instruments)

landmark_outputs.description: SUPER-style partial-credit grading — 2–6 intermediate output file patterns ordered by pipeline stage

linked_result_ids.description: Result IDs from the claim/result ledger that this card primarily grades

methodology_summary.description: Ordered list of plain-text procedure steps

missing_information.description: Gaps, inaccessible artifacts, and unknowns noted by the extraction agent

parameters.description: Resolved task parameters, one JSON object per parameter; empty when parameter resolution did not run

primary_domain.description: Primary scientific domain identified by the classifier

project_id.description: Project assignment ID; null when the card has no project assignment

prov.description: Provenance links of the card (entities used and entities that influenced it)

provenance_source.description: Source category of the paper this card was extracted from

related_repos.description: Repositories linked to the source that are not the task's own repository (dependencies, upstream engines, mirrors), as owner/repo strings

reproducibility_tier.description: Tier describing how reproducible this card's workflow step is

research_question.description: The scientific question this task addresses

resumption_contract.description: How a workflow resumes at this step when the step cannot be re-executed; null when not needed

review_questions.description: Open questions for a human reviewer of this card

run_command.description: Shell command that re-runs the task for verification; null means skip

run_cwd.description: Working directory for run_command (relative to capsule dir)

scenario_id.description: Scenario assignment ID; null when the card has no scenario assignment

scitask_version.description: Version of the task specification (the reference pipeline writes 0.1.1); the slot keeps its name from before the rename to ASB

script_refs.description: Links from workflow steps to source-file line ranges, one JSON object per link: {step, file_path, chunk_name, chunk_type, start_line, end_line, score}

section_provenance.description: Unique source_section values back-filled from linked claims' source_anchor

skills.description: Reusable capabilities required to complete the task

source_package.description: Path or identifier of the research article package this card was synthesized from

spine_condition_ids.description: Identifiers of the paper-level conditions the card refers to; empty when no entity spine was built

spine_entity_ids.description: Identifiers of the paper-level entities the card refers to; empty when no entity spine was built

subdomains.description: Secondary scientific sub-domains identified by the classifier

synthesized_from.description: Source from which this card was synthesized (e.g. article, github:owner/repo, web:https://..., mixed)

task_description.description: Full natural-language description of the task

task_id.description: Unique identifier for this task (e.g. task_001 or doi-slug__task_001)

task_inputs.description: Typed input ports of the task, for dataflow between cards

task_kind.description: How this card relates to the source paper (reproduction of a reported result, derived analysis, reconstruction of a described mechanism, or an extension beyond the paper). Optional; absent means unclassified.

task_objective.description: One-sentence task objective (LLM mode; empty string when not populated)

task_outputs.description: Typed output ports of the task, for dataflow between cards

techniques.description: Key experimental or computational techniques used

tools.description: Software tools, databases, and APIs used in the task

uncertainty_notes.description: Gaps and ambiguities in the card's fields

workflow_description.description: Step-by-step methodology for executing the task

ASBTaskCard.title: ASBTaskCard

ArtifactConfidenceEnum.description: Detection confidence level for a typed artifact
ArtifactConfidenceEnum.title: ArtifactConfidenceEnum

ArtifactDetectionMethodEnum.description: Method used to detect artifact format
ArtifactDetectionMethodEnum.title: ArtifactDetectionMethodEnum

ArtifactProvenanceEntry.description: Provenance record for a single file in the capsule, recording how it was produced and where it was sourced from.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this artifact was produced

jsonpath.description: JSONPath into the emitting agent's output locating this artifact

path.description: Relative path to the file within the capsule directory

source.description: Source agent or process that produced this file

ArtifactProvenanceEntry.title: ArtifactProvenanceEntry

ArtifactSourceEnum.description: Source agent or process that produced a file in the capsule
ArtifactSourceEnum.title: ArtifactSourceEnum

AvailableArtifact.description: A file or data artifact accessible from the research paper package. Records its path, role in the workflow, whether it is indexable, and an optional content hash.

indexable.description: Whether this artifact's content is indexed for retrieval

path.description: Relative path to the artifact within the package

role.description: Semantic role of the artifact (e.g. raw_data, figure, script)

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the artifact content

AvailableArtifact.title: AvailableArtifact

ComputeTierEnum.description: Compute requirement tier for task execution
ComputeTierEnum.title: ComputeTierEnum

EvaluationStrategy.description: Structured evaluation plan for an ASB task card, aligned with the p-plan:Plan concept. Specifies direct automated checks and expert-review criteria.

direct_checks.description: List of automated, deterministic checks that can be run without human review (e.g., file existence, column count, value ranges).

expert_review.description: List of criteria requiring human or expert judgment (e.g., scientific validity, reproducibility within tolerance).

EvaluationStrategy.title: EvaluationStrategy

EvidenceSnippet.description: A verbatim text snippet extracted from the source paper that supports a claim or field in the ASB task card.

reason.description: Why this snippet was selected as evidence

snippet_id.description: Unique identifier for this snippet (e.g. snip_001)

source_path.description: Relative path to the source file from which this snippet was extracted

text.description: Verbatim text of the evidence snippet

EvidenceSnippet.title: EvidenceSnippet

ExecutableSpec.description: A runnable command bound to an ASB task card.

cmd.description: Command as a list of arguments (no shell string)

env.description: Environment variables set for the command, as a JSON object of names to values

grounding_notes.description: Why the command could not be confirmed, when inferred is true

inferred.description: True when the command could not be confirmed against the files of the source package and is a best-effort inference

ExecutableSpec.title: ExecutableSpec

ExecutionEnvironment.description: Software/hardware/scheduler/agentic context that ran or is required to run a card or workflow.

container_image.description: Docker or Singularity container image URI

hardware_profile.description: Hardware profile description (e.g. CPU, GPU, RAM)

llm_models.description: LLM model IDs used during card synthesis

lockfile_path.description: Path to the lockfile (e.g. requirements.txt, uv.lock)

scheduler_resources.description: Resources requested from the scheduler (for example nodes, memory and wall time), as a JSON object

tools_versions.description: Versions of the tools used, as a JSON object of tool names to versions

ExecutionEnvironment.title: ExecutionEnvironment

ExecutionProfile.description: Execution and tool requirements for a scientific task.

commercial_software.description: List of commercial or proprietary software tools required

compute_tier.description: Compute requirement tier for task execution

ExecutionProfile.title: ExecutionProfile

JsonObject.description: Arbitrary JSON object; members may be any JSON values.
JsonObject.title: JsonObject

ProvenanceLinks.description: PROV-O-inspired links for an ASB task card.

used.description: IRIs or IDs of entities used (inputs, prior task outputs)

was_influenced_by.description: IRIs or IDs of entities that influenced this card

ProvenanceLinks.title: ProvenanceLinks

ProvenanceSourceEnum.description: Source from which an ASB task card was synthesized
ProvenanceSourceEnum.title: ProvenanceSourceEnum

ReproducibilityTierEnum.description: Tier describing how reproducible a card's workflow step is
ReproducibilityTierEnum.title: ReproducibilityTierEnum

ResumptionContract.description: Recipe for resuming a workflow at a step whose runner cannot re-execute (bypassed compute, commercial/GUI software, wet-lab step).

alt_cli_method.description: CLI alternative or manual SOP for manual-only steps

cached_outputs.description: Hash-pinned artifact paths for bypassed steps

pseudo_outputs.description: Wet-lab stand-in outputs for experimental steps

ResumptionContract.title: ResumptionContract

SciTaskCapsule.description: An RO-Crate 1.1 package that wraps an ASB task card with supporting evidence, provenance, evaluation manifests, and embedded scripts. Conforms to schema:Dataset, rocrate:Dataset, and pplan:Plan. Workflow Run Crate alignment is tracked in the reference pipeline.

artifact_provenance.description: Provenance manifest for all files in the capsule

capsule_card.description: The ASB task card embedded in this capsule

capsule_created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this capsule was created

capsule_dir.description: Relative or absolute path to the capsule directory on disk

capsule_task_id.description: Unique identifier for this capsule; typically doi-slug__task_NNN. Matches the task_id in the embedded ASBTaskCard.

profile_version.description: Version of the RO-Crate profile the crate declares, if any (e.g. 0.5)

SciTaskCapsule.title: SciTaskCapsule

TaskKindEnum.description: What an ASB task card represents relative to the source paper: a result the paper empirically reported, a derived re-analysis, a described-but-not- separately-validated mechanism, or a task beyond the paper's reported scope.
TaskKindEnum.title: TaskKindEnum

TaskPort.description: A single typed data port (input or output) on an ASB task card.

edam_format_uri.description: EDAM format IRI for the data format of this port

edam_operation_uri.description: EDAM operation IRI for the operation that produces or consumes this port

evidence_id.description: ID of the EvidenceSnippet that supports this port's existence

port_role.description: Role of the port; "environment" marks a port that declares the software under study rather than data. Absent or null means not flagged.

resolved_via.description: How the port was resolved to a concrete source, as a JSON object; null when the port is unresolved

source_dataset.description: Repository or dataset name for the source

TaskPort.title: TaskPort

ToolAlternative.description: A closed-source / open-source tool pair with optional divergence notes.

expected_divergence.description: Notes on expected behavioral or performance divergence

ToolAlternative.title: ToolAlternative

TypedArtifact.description: A typed, format-identified artifact (input or output) of an ASB task card. Pairs 1-to-1 with an entry in inputs[] or expected_outputs[].

content_signature.description: Short content hint from magic-byte matching (e.g. <?xml)

description.description: Original prose string from the card (verbatim)

format_id.description: Short format key (e.g. mzML) matching a FormatSpec.name

instrument_class.description: Advisory instrument class hint extracted from article text

ontology_class.description: PSI-MS or fallback OBO class string (e.g. MS:1000584)

TypedArtifact.title: TypedArtifact
